title: Power Rankings: Mavericks back on top
heading: 2010-11 Power Rankings: Week 9
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Very aware that the Mavs lost on a Monday last time we had them No. 1, and that they're playing Monday night at OKC after a rust-building five days off. None of that can matter when this is where they deserve to be.

rankings.summaryHtml: I knew the Celts had been good before Christmas in the KG era, but I didn't know they were this good until Elias informed us that Boston's 94-14 mark is the best pre-Christmas over any four-season span in NBA history.

rankings.summaryHtml: How do you go 14-1 after starting 9-8? A softer schedule certainly helps, but so does this: Miami is allowing nearly eight fewer points per game (from 94.5 ppg to 86.7 ppg) and grabbing nearly six more boards nightly.
